target_schema.state: PW_COMPLEX_FLOQUET_STATE_V1; integrated 3D Coupling truth; POSTNP +z; seven ordered propagating orders; TE/TM complex coordinates over 445–455 nm
target_schema.state_representation: original C_PW and C_hat/P_scale factorization; seven order-local rank-2 PCA representations fit only on outer-training geometries
target_schema.scale: POSTNP_TOTAL_POWER_V2 / P_scale; frozen RBF Kernel Ridge scale branch; no oracle substitution

geometry_grouping.inner: 3-fold geometry GroupKFold within the outer training geometries

A1.name: NP_LF_PHYSICS
A1.definition: seven LF order-vector scalars plus LF T_proxy at each paired wavelength; P_XLIKE, ux=0, ky=0

preprocessing.A0_input_scaling: D1..D6 divided by 130 nm; StandardScaler fit only on each training split
preprocessing.A1_input_capacity_match_if_enabled_in_fu: concatenate six ordered geometry values and 88 LF values; training-fold StandardScaler then training-fold PCA to six inputs before the same width-32 model; no test fold fit
preprocessing.state_pca: seven order-specific rank-2 PCA transformations fit using training geometries only
preprocessing.P_scale_model: RBF Kernel Ridge; train-fold X/y StandardScaler; alpha {0.1,1,10}, gamma {0.1,1}; grouped inner selection

model_selection.state_model: frozen PW_K6_STRUCTURED_FORWARD_MODEL_V1; shared Linear(6,32)-ReLU-Linear(32,32)-ReLU encoder; seven Linear(32,2) order heads; 14→32→14 residual fusion
model_selection.early_stopping_objective: normalized MSE on geometry-held inner validation fold
model_selection.prediction_aggregation: mean of the three fixed-seed predictions; no post-hoc seed selection

comparative_acceptance_logic.supported: at least one legal NP arm improves both state and routing median RMSE by >=5%, wins on >=60% of geometries for both endpoints (12/20 for 20G; 20/32 for 32G), and does not worsen state/routing q95 by >10% or worst-case error by >25%; key absolute-order and total-power medians/q95 must not materially degrade; report OOD strata and seed stability
comparative_acceptance_logic.partial: measurable but target-specific/small improvement, OOD-stratum sensitivity, or unstable q95/worst-case behavior
comparative_acceptance_logic.not_supported: no meaningful incremental improvement or consistent degradation
comparative_acceptance_logic.blocked: formal matched labels/provider values are insufficient or fail integrity/coverage gates
comparative_acceptance_logic.production_H1_is_separate: all frozen conjunctive H1 gates must pass; feature utility never implies production admission

ood_stratification: stable sort by normalized nearest HF22 distance then case_id; 7/7/6 nearest/middle/farthest; diagnostics only

feature_coverage_gate.rule: no sorting, interpolation, synthetic LF extrapolation, HF truth substitution, or missing-value imputation; stop before training
